title: Alekhine Defense: the ideas
line: The knight invites White's pawns forward, and Black attacks them once they are far from home.

steps.text: White starts by pushing the pawn in front of its king two squares, into the center.
Bring the knight out to hit the pawn on e4. Black invites the pawn to chase it.

steps.text: Step the knight to d5. White's pawn on e5 cannot reach it there, and it eyes c3 and e3.
Push the pawn on d7 one square. It hits White's pawn on e5.
The pawn on c4 hits your knight. Step back to b6.
Tap every white pawn that has moved.
steps.after: Black gave White space, and in return those pawns are far from home, where Black's pieces can attack them.

summary: The Alekhine knight invites White's pawns forward, then Black attacks them while they are far from home.
